summary: Network & cloud security engineer with 4+ years securing enterprise and hybrid-cloud environments for global organizations including Daimler/Mercedes-Benz, now building cybersecurity products at Authenticone. PCNSE-certified expert in multi-vendor firewalls (Palo Alto NGFW, Panorama, FortiGate, Check Point, Cisco Firepower), VPN, NAT, high availability, and routing (BGP/OSPF) across Azure and AWS, with a proven record of owning high-severity incidents end-to-end under 24x7 SLAs. I pair deep operator experience with a builder's mindset to design secure, resilient systems and the tooling security teams actually need.

experience.title: Senior Cybersecurity Consultant
highlights: Build and enhance cybersecurity products end-to-end — including developing and extending an endpoint detection & response (EDR) tool — from threat model to shipped feature
Translate 4+ years of frontline firewall, VPN, and cloud-security experience into product features that solve real security-operator workflows
Apply threat modeling and secure-development practices across the SDLC

experience.title: Cyber Security Consultant
highlights: Delivered end-to-end cybersecurity consulting including problem analysis, effort estimation, firewall architecture design, and deployment across enterprise environments
Provided L2/L3 support for multi-vendor firewalls (Palo Alto, FortiGate, Check Point, Cisco Firepower), managing security policies, NAT, VPNs, upgrades, and high-availability configurations
Led POCs for firewall and cloud security solutions, conducted vulnerability assessments, and implemented security hardening for 24x7 SLA-driven production systems

experience.title: Senior System Engineer
highlights: Served as L2/L3 escalation engineer for enterprise-scale Palo Alto NGFW deployments, resolving high-severity network and security incidents within strict SLA targets

Designed, deployed, and supported secure hybrid cloud architectures across Azure, AWS, and VMware ESXi, including advanced troubleshooting of GlobalProtect, IPsec/SSL VPNs, GRE, MACSec, and routing (BGP, OSPF)

Built and operated replication lab environments to isolate OS-level defects, performed deep packet inspection using Wireshark, and delivered 1000+ enterprise security solutions across large datacenter environments
Designed and supported high-availability firewall and application load-balancing (LTM/HLB) architectures, automated workflows using Ansible and PowerShell, and mentored junior engineers
